sections.label: SegretarIA
sections.name: Segretar
sections.lead: Your new right hand for messages, reminders, accounting and customers: she works quietly and asks for your confirmation when needed.

disclaimer.title: Human-in-the-loop
disclaimer.text: It means you always have the final say. The AI prepares, suggests and organises; a person checks and decides. Every message proposed by SegretarIA goes through you: you can approve it as it is or personalise it before it's sent.

features.title: Incoming and outgoing messages
features.text: SegretarIA reads your customers' requests and suggests a reply. You approve it with a tap, or personalise it by hand before sending it.

features.title: Customer reminders, automatically
features.text: You set them up as you need: a reminder the day before an appointment to ask for confirmation, or as often as you decide to remember a deadline or a follow-up. Great for customer loyalty.

features.title: Your accounting in one dashboard
features.text: Income, expenses and deadlines in one place, with reminders for customers' unpaid invoices.

features.title: A tailor-made CRM
features.text: It keeps track of all your customers: who they are, what they asked for, when you last heard from them.

features.title: Weekly statistics and reports
features.text: Every week a report to see the results achieved. On top of that, SegretarIA adds a short comment with her analysis.

sections.example: Already have someone answering your customers? Well, from today you can also call them ‘Customer Success Specialist’, while SegretarIA takes care of the repetitive paperwork.

closing.title: Did you know?
closing.text: Meta's bot (WhatsApp, Facebook, Instagram) doesn't allow a process with built-in Human-in-the-loop (explained above). We found a way to solve this problem, giving life to your new, irreplaceable right hand: SegretarIA.

cta.message: Hi C.PINSAI, I'd like to try SegretarIA free for a month.
